description: Stops or deletes the explainer clip at the video provider. Side effect: the task is deleted there and, once a clip is finished, the video file itself is removed, which cannot be undone; it stops any further cost. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id`, the `task_id` from wi_create_explainer_video and a clear yes (`confirm` true). Use it when the clip runs too long or the host does not want it; wi_get_explainer_video shows what the provider reports now.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said the clip may be deleted.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_cancel_explainer_video
title: Stop an explainer clip
